sources.entry: DynamicHorizon - Adds media controls, notifications, and system indicators to the notch area.

summary.name: DynamicHorizon
summary.one_liner: DynamicHorizon is a macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style area for media controls, notifications, and system indicators.
use_cases: control music playback from the notch
view notifications in the notch area
show brightness and sound levels on screen
display lyrics and widgets on the lock screen
run timers and privacy indicators from the notch
customize the Mac notch with animated modules
summary.what_it_does: DynamicHorizon adds a Dynamic Island-style interface to the macOS notch. It offers media controls, music and lyrics display, and notifications in one place. System controls include brightness, sound, privacy modules, and timers. The page says it has 20+ notch modules and a lock screen display for music, lyrics, and custom widgets. It is described as built with macOS 27's Liquid Glass design.
notable: Lock screen music, lyrics, and custom widgets
Built for macOS 27 Liquid Glass design
caveats: Pricing and availability are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing; specific feature details are limited
